headline: HSBC Shares Fall 5% Despite 32% Q3 Profit Gain and $1 Billion Share Buyback
summary: HSBC reported a 32% increase in third-quarter pre-tax profit to $9.6 billion, missing average analyst estimates. The bank announced a new $1 billion share buyback program as its stock fell 5%.
why: HSBC is one of the world's largest banking and financial services organizations, headquartered in London and heavily exposed to Asian markets.

impacts.name: HSBC Holdings plc
impacts.why: Quarterly pre-tax profit missed consensus analyst expectations, weighing on share prices.

why_moved: HSBC shares fell after third-quarter pre-tax profits came in slightly below consensus market expectations.
